feedback.problem: Given that $X∼\text{Geom}(0.45),$ compute $P(3<X\le 7)$ rounded to $4$ decimal places.
feedback.worked_solution:
If $X∼\text{Geom}(p),$ then $X$ has the following probability mass function:

$$
f(x)={\begin{aligned}(1-p)^{x-1}p, & x=1,2,3,… \\ 0, & \text{otherwise}\end{aligned}
$$

Here, $X∼\text{Geom}(0.45),$ so the distribution of $X$ in this case is

$$
f(x)={\begin{aligned}(0.55)^{x-1}(0.45), & x=1,2,3,… \\ 0, & \text{otherwise}.\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore,

$$
\begin{aligned}P(3<X\le 7) & =P(X\in {4,5,6,7}) \\  & =P(X=4)+P(X=5)+P(X=6)+P(X=7) \\  & =f(4)+f(5)+f(6)+f(7) \\  & =(0.55)^{3}(0.45)+(0.55)^{4}(0.45)+(0.55)^{5}(0.45)+(0.55)^{6}(0.45) \\  & ≈0.1512.\end{aligned}
$$
